change: Page Up/Down in the arrow popup and Vim center toggle
behavior: PgUp and PgDn fill the two previously empty upper corners of the arrow popup, preserving its 200dp width and 100dp key area. Standard Page Up/Down sequences and Shift modifiers use the existing guarded input pipeline. Held page keys respect Android long-press activation and repeat every 160ms; arrow and Backspace repeat retain their defaults. The Vim radial center returns Back inside a group and closes the menu at root; the AssistiveTouch button reopens it. Existing page wrapping, open-menu dragging and edge positioning remain.
